BiblicalUsage: Faultlessly, unblamably, and Paul uses it twice for the life he lived and the life he prays for. Ye are witnesses, and God also, how holily and justly and unblameably we behaved ourselves among you that believe. And he prays that the whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
TheologicalSignificance: A word for faultlessly carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the two uses, that Paul lived unblamably among the Thessalonians and prayed they would be kept blameless until Christ comes.
